info.title: geoconvert-app - a desktop map converter, renderer and diff tool.
info.description: A WinForms desktop app and .NET tool that converts maps between geospatial formats, renders them to PNG/SVG, and diffs two maps. Built on GeoConvert.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Run with no arguments to open the window. Pass a map file to open it directly.

commands.name: associate
commands.description: Bind the supported map formats to this app.

options.name: --side-by-side
options.description:
Overlay both maps on one canvas (default) or place them
side by side at a shared extent.

options.name: --color-a
options.description: Colour for the first map (default red).

options.name: --color-b
options.description: Colour for the second map (default blue).

options.name: --bbox
options.description: Extent to render (defaults to the union of both maps).

options.name: --size
options.description: Image size in pixels.

options.name: --max-dimension
options.description: Cap the longer edge at this many pixels (fit-to-box).

options.name: --projection
options.description: auto | plate-carree | web-mercator | lambert | goode.

options.name: --renderer
options.description: builtin (default), skia or imagesharp (PNG only).
